title: Numeric accessors return the current token at its requested precision
summary: After reading decimal 2.5, the integer view of the next token 7.5 now returned 7. Reading a large number as double first preserved all digits on a later BigInteger access.

change.description: Jackson clears deferred numeric state across tokens and retains the text needed for later exact conversions on the same token.

notes: BigInteger on the original decimal text is an independent exact oracle, unaffected by the consumer’s earlier request for a double.
With identical compiled caller bytes, 2.21.8 matched the parent and 2.21.9 matched the landing on all three histories.
